leadText: Adventures in Running Errands! (Japanese: ハリマロン！はじめてのおつかい！！ ! Its First Errand!!) is the 84th episode of Pokémon the Series: XY, and the 883rd episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on August 13, 2015, in Canada on October 3, 2015, and in the United States on October 10, 2015.
plainText:
Adventures in Running Errands! (Japanese: ハリマロン！はじめてのおつかい！！ ! Its First Errand!!) is the 84th episode of Pokémon the Series: XY, and the 883rd episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on August 13, 2015, in Canada on October 3, 2015, and in the United States on October 10, 2015.
 

==Blurb==
 
 Our heroes have stopped at a busy Pokémon Center to get out of the rain when the power goes out! Clemont soon discovers that a leak in the roof has caused a short circuit, and recruits Luxray, Pikachu, and Dedenne to serve as a temporary source of electricity while he fixes it. Ash climbs up to repair the leak, and Serena and Bonnie offer to help Nurse Joy take care of the Pokémon.

Clemont needs a replacement fuse, but he can’t leave the still-sparking fuse box unattended, and everyone else is still hard at work. So he sends Chespin and Bunnelby into town with a note for the shopkeeper! Along the way, the two Pokémon run into Team Rocket...but just as Ash shows up looking for Chespin and Bunnelby, they send the villains blasting off all by themselves!

Eventually, they acquire the new fuse and bring it back to Clemont, who gets the power going again, and all is well...all except for Chespin, who eats way too much at the victory feast and becomes the newly restored Pokémon Center’s first patient! 

==Plot==
 and reach a Pokémon Center after being caught in a downpour. In the meantime, and Ash's other Pokémon receive a check up by Nurse Joy and . After exclaims that the rain is never going to stop, pulls out his invention called the "Weather Predictor" which collects data including the movement of rain clouds, wind, humidity and temperature to predict the weather, although the results will take a full day to come in. Clemont raises the analysis speed to make it work faster, but this causes the invention to explode.

Later, Ash receives his Pokémon back and Nurse Joy states they are all perfectly fine. The rain, however, has not stopped. The downpour manages to leak through the ceiling and causes a black out in the Pokémon Center. Clemont immediately asks if he can have a look at the main electricity system, so Nurse Joy and Wigglytuff guide them to it. With a quick inspection, Clemont realizes the leak has caused a . Nurse Joy worries because she is still in the middle of treating some Pokémon. Clemont is determined to fix the problem. Clemont calls out his , and suggests they use their Pokémon could power the Pokémon Center for a while. As Luxray, Pikachu and provide a charge, Clemont starts working on the repairs. Ash, Serena and Bonnie wish them good luck and leave.

Since all the equipment is down, Nurse Joy hands out for the time being. Serena and Bonnie volunteer to help Nurse Joy hand out the berries, while Nurse Joy leaves to attend to a Pokémon requiring special treatment. Meanwhile, Ash decides that he will focus on repairing the roof, and climbs up to inspect the damage which proves to be a few missing shingles. He sends out and to help. Firstly, he asks Frogadier to make some frubbles to stop him from slipping, which allows Ash to take a closer look at the damaged section. While Hawlucha holds down a plank of wood, Ash asks Frogadier to inspect the roof for more holes. Meanwhile, scrubs the wet floor down next to Clemont, while Dedenne snoozes off.

After a while, Nurse Joy comes to see Clemont and check on his progress. Clemont asks for a spare fuse. Nurse Joy replies that she has no spare, but that there is a store nearby. Suddenly, the system explodes again and Clemont goes hurriedly back into work. suddenly comes out of its Ball, and joins Bunnelby in heading out to get the fuse. Stepping outside, Clemont is pleased that rain has finally stopped. Clemont straps a purse around Chespin's neck containing instructions for Chespin to show the shopkeeper. He instructs Chespin and Bunnelby that the shop is straight down the path and warns them not to stray. Ash asks where the two are going to and Clemont answers that they are heading off on an errand. Clemont goes inside while Ash continues fixing the roof. 

Spying an opportunity, set their sights on capturing Chespin and Bunnelby and to reel in Pikachu. Chespin soon becomes distracted, jumping in puddles, straying into a food shop and chasing after a in admiration, with Bunnelby pulling Chespin into line each time. Chespin assures Bunnelby that everything is fine, and holds up the purse, only for a to swoop in and steal it. The two chase after it, Chespin attempts to retrieve the purse by using its vines. After this fails, Chespin throws Bunnelby into the air and Bunnelby successfully grabs onto the purse and retrieves it. The Fearow is unimpressed and chases after the two. Bunnelby digs a hole which they use to escape the Fearow. However, afterwards they realize they have strayed far off the path. Back at the Pokémon Center, Ash comes back inside after finishing the roof repairs and checks on Clemont and exclaims Chespin and Bunnelby have been gone for a long time. Ash decides to send out a search party, and calls out and to search from the air.

Meanwhile, Chespin and Bunnelby continue to the store, but eventually encounter . James asks them to surrender. However, Chespin and Bunnelby decide to fight them. Jessie sends out and commands her to use . James takes out and asks them to surrender again. teases them that they cannot even do one simple errand, and Chespin remembers that Clemont is counting on it to finish the errand. Chespin charges forward, but Inkay retaliates with . James orders Inkay to fire a but Bunnelby blocks it with . Jessie commands Gourgeist to use , which Chespin blocks with . Jessie gets mad and commands Gourgeist to use Shadow Ball again. However, the attack is blocked by Fletchinder, and Ash and Noibat arrive on the scene and prepare to take the battle from there. However, Chespin sees an opportunity, and whispers its plan of attack to Bunnelby. Bunnelby follows through by digging and emerging to fire a Mud Shot directly at Team Rocket and their Pokémon. Chespin then uses causing to blast off. Afterwards, Ash remarks that he needn't need to worry all along and tells the pair to finish the errand.

Bunnelby and Chespin later return to the Pokémon Center, handing the purchased fuse over to Clemont. Clemont thanks them for their help before installing the new fuse to fix the system, while Luxray and Pikachu continue to power the Center. Clemont completes his repair job and turns the electricity back on. Nurse Joy thanks the group for all their help them, rewarding them with food. Clemont tells Chespin that it can eat all that it liked because of all its help. However, Chespin eats until it feels sick. Nurse Joy and Wigglytuff immediately rush Chespin off for treatment. While the others sigh, Serena jokes that Chespin is the first patient after the power has been turned back on.

==Trivia==
 
In the Japanese version, the title card segment focuses on, and is read by, .
Professor Oak's Pokémon Holo Caster: 
Instead of Pokémon Holo Caster, scenes from the eighteenth Pokémon movie were shown.
This episode is a reference to the Japanese reality TV show , where small children do errands for their parents.
This is another time where the Pokémon Quiz segment features a Pokémon that has already been featured. In this case, was featured 74 episodes ago.
Music from Meloetta's Moonlight Serenade is used in this episode.
Brilliantly is used as an insert song in this episode.
narrates the preview for the next episode.

===Errors===
When is revealing , he is seen wearing his backpack despite the fact that he left it earlier, but in the next scene, he isn't wearing it.
In one scene, 's tooth is colored gray just like its skin instead of white.
According to this tweet by the series executive animation director , Tomohiro Koyama was incorrectly credited as animation director instead of as assistant executive animation director and Miyabi Ozeki was incorrectly credited as assistant animation director instead of as animation director in the ending credits.
 
File:XY084 error.png|Ash with his backpack
File:XY084 error 2.png|Bunnelby's tooth error
 

===Dub edits===
The title card segment is read by Ash instead of .
Brilliantly was replaced with an instrumental song, and and Bunnelby's voices were added to the scene that was previously unvoiced in the dub.
